ud6.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
ud6.1:1.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi,
ud6.1:1.4: Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:1.6: yena Cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ ten' upasaṅkamissāmi divāvihārāyā 'ti.
ud6.1:2.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho pana āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanam ādāya bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
ud6.1:2.2: atha kho bhagavā yena Cāpālacetiyaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi,
ud6.1:2.3: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:3.1: ramaṇīyā Ānanda Vesālī, ramaṇīyaṃ Udenaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Gotamakaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Sattambaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Bahuputtaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Sārandadaṃ cetiyaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ Cāpālaṃ cetiyaṃ.
ud6.1:3.2: yassa kassaci Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā 'ti.
ud6.1:3.3: tathāgatassa kho Ānanda cattāro iddhipādā . . . susamāraddhā, ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā 'ti.
ud6.1:4.1: evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne n' āsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ,
ud6.1:4.3: tiṭṭhatu bhante bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan ti yathā taṃ Mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
ud6.1:5.3: tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā 'ti.
ud6.1:6.1: evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando . . . pe . . . pariyuṭṭhitacitto. tatiyam pi
ud6.1:6.3: bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi: ramaṇīyā . . . pe . . . tathāgato kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kappāvasesaṃ vā 'ti. evam pi kho āyasmā Ānando . . . pe . . . pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
ud6.1:7.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud6.1:7.2: gaccha tvaṃ Ānanda, yassa dāni kālaṃ maññasī 'ti.
ud6.1:7.3: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
ud6.1:8.1: atha kho Māro pāpimā acirapakkante āyasmante Ānande yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi, ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Māro pāpimā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud6.1:9.1: parinibbātu dāni bhante bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante bhagavato,
ud6.1:9.2: bhāsitā kho pan' esā bhante bhagavatā vācā:
ud6.1:9.3: na tāv' āhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhū na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā pattayogakkhemā bahussutā dhammadharā dhammānudhammapaṭipannā sāmīcipaṭipannā anudhammacārino sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desissanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti vivarissanti vibhajissanti uttānikarissanti, uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ saha dhammena suniggahitan niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī 'ti.
ud6.1:9.4: santi kho pana bhante etarahi bhikkhū bhagavato sāvakā viyattā . . . uggahetvā ācikkhanti desenti paññapenti paṭṭhapenti vivaranti vibhajanti uttānikaronti uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ saha dhammena suniggahitan niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:9.5: parinibbātu dāni bhante bhagavā, parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante bhagavato,
ud6.1:10.1: bhāsitā kho pan' esā bhagavatā vācā:
ud6.1:10.2: na tāv' āhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā . . . pe . . . anudhammacāriniyo . . . pe . . . sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī 'ti.
ud6.1:10.3: santi kho pana bhante etarahi bhikkhuniyo bhagavato sāvikā . . . pe . . . sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:11.2: na tāv' āhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me upāsakā na sāvakā bhavissanti viyattā . . . pe . . . sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desissantī 'ti.
ud6.1:11.3: etarahi kho pana bhante upāsakā bhagavato sāvakā viyattā . . . pe . . . sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:12.2: na tāv' āhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me upāsikā na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā . . . pe . . . anudhammacāriniyo . . . pe . . . sappāṭihāriyam dhammaṃ desissantī 'ti.
ud6.1:12.3: etarahi kho pana bhante upāsikā bhagavato sāvikā viyattā . . . pe . . . anudhammacāriniyo . . . pe . . . sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.
ud6.1:13.2: na tāv' āhaṃ pāpima parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ na iddhaṃ ca bhavissati phītaṃ ca vitthārikaṃ bahujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva-d-eva manussehi suppakāsitan ti.
ud6.1:13.3: etarahi kho pana bhante bhagavato brahmacariyaṃ iddhaṃ ca phītaṃ ca vitthārikaṃ bahujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yavad eva manussehi suppakāsitan ti
ud6.1:13.4: parinibbātu dāni bhante bhagavā parinibbātu sugato, parinibbānakālo dāni bhante bhagavato 'ti.
ud6.1:14.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā Māraṃ pāpimantaṃ etad avoca:
ud6.1:14.2: apposukko tvaṃ pāpima hohi. na ciraṃ tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati,
ud6.1:14.3: ito tiṇṇaṃ māsānaṃ accayena tathāgato parinibbāyissatī 'ti.
ud6.1:15.1: atha kho bhagavā Cāpāle cetiye sato sampajāno āyusaṅkhāraṃ ossajji,
ud6.1:15.2: ossaṭṭhe ca bhagavatā āyusaṅkhāre mahābhūmicālo ahosi bhiṃsanako lomahaṃso devadundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
ud6.1:16.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
